warning: the CMA account opening date uses the first supplied statement date because that statement proves no carried account or SPAXX balance; verify the bundle starts at legal account opening.
warning: A2 peak is blank because same-day credits and debits lack a shared timestamp/order. Audit columns contain the proven lower bound and conservative upper bound, each converted at its own date's TTBR; under the default native-currency peak selection their rupee order can differ from the native order. To file one, set [fidelity_cma].suppress_peak_balance_warning = true and choose peak_balance_bound = "lower" or "upper"; upper is more conservative in native currency and may overstate, while lower may understate the actual intraday peak. An attested bound is refused when the lower bound converts to more rupees than the upper.
